reviewKind: agent-assisted prospective semantic authoring review; not retrospective human audit
summary: Reviewed all 27 generated cases and 432 H requirement instances, all Q/W obligations, D ordinary/prompted timing, withheld controls, delivered-evidence boundaries, three-arm workflow contracts, strict scoring and invocation accounting. Confirmed authoring defects were corrected prospectively and tested. Mixed current-context Q controls, missing full-bank opposing strata, always-active demanding branches and limited family/noise coverage remain explicit limitations. Initial review was independent of the implementation owners; this reviewer subsequently implemented confirmed corrections and focused tests. This is agent-assisted authoring review, not independent human certification or a retrospective outcome audit. No provider calls, evaluated sessions, prior-result rescoring or token-ledger changes occurred.

scopeLimitations.text: Incident q-avoid-environment (staging) and experiment q-avoid-instrument (K4), where present, can be answered from current task/contract. Exact affected case IDs are listed in matrix[].memoryReliance.QCurrentContextControls. These are behavior controls, not independent evidence of memory retention. Other historical Q fields still require memory; overall task use also depends on delivered mapping/artifact prerequisites.

Easy unresolved incident and experiment have no active necessary questions or fresh-work milestones. Q/W balanced ratings are unavailable there; do not invent pass credit or silently drop cases. Current strict full-bank aggregation will remain unavailable for those metrics unless a new authoring/scoring version explicitly defines the relevant strata.

Demanding conditional discriminator values activate the dependent branch in every authored case. Tests cover timing and unrelated inactive-field exclusion, not a balanced study of active and inactive conditional outcomes.

Identity-withheld controls isolate D/identity-dependent work. Release unresolved instead removes historical license result and all originating echoes, allowing a new current check without inventing historical execution. These narrow controls do not prove every H/Q/W requirement independently relies on memory.

Noise is explicitly marked unrelated; 27 cells reuse three causal families. Structural validation and local witnesses establish feasibility, not live difficulty, held-out generalization, model semantic reliability or product benefit.
This is an agent-assisted authoring review and focused deterministic testing. It is not the pending human audit of saved v5 results and does not rescore, replace or validate prior outcomes.

authorization: This review is not operator authorization to dispatch evaluated agents.
